newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen to ban futures houses from stock trading.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen to ban futures houses from stock trading.

text.p: Shenzhen's financial regulators have ordered local futures brokerages to stop trading securities by the end of this month, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Thursday.
The move is aimed at enforcing state financial regulations and fostering the healthy development of the securities market, the newspaper said.

The order came in a notice jointly issued by the Shenzhen Securities Management Office, the Shenzhen Futures Management Office and the Shenzhen branch of the central People's Bank of China on Wednesday.

Under its terms, securities brokerages are not allowed to lease trading seats to futures trading houses and securities accounts opened by futures brokerages must be transferred to authorised securities brokerages by end-April.

Brokerages failing to carry out the order face a fine of between one and five million yuan as well as the risk of having their business licences stripped and profits from securities transactions confiscated, it said.
Serious offenders will be subject to criminal prosecution, the notice added.
